description: Security default: from the outermost seat, continues past the user tier on the organization's classic hooks, prompt content, settings and subjects, at session.append for the rows the engine injects, a compaction's rows, a skill the Skill tool hands over and an organization plugin's notes, and at session.compact, refuses a user-tier tool.register under an MCP allowlist or under a name that reads as one of the organization's servers or plugins, restores the organization's tools in tool.list, holds a deny, and an ask a settings rule, a classic hook or an organization's ask cap decided, whole over what the user tier makes of it on tool.check, continues past the user tier's hooks for an organization plugin's log lines and its reads and writes of the environment, refuses a user-tier write of a variable managed env sets, of the launcher's variable where policy names a launcher and of the variables that move where policy and sign-in are read from, and refuses a user-tier hooks module at plugin.register while managed settings set its allowManagedModsOnly option
